title: v0 vs Cursor (2026): UI Components vs AI Code Editor — Which One to Use?
summary: v0 vs Cursor: one generates React components, the other edits code. Different tools for different jobs. Plus: why many builders use Blink instead of either.
body_markdown: Yes — many developers use v0 to generate initial components, then bring them into Cursor to iterate and connect to a backend. They serve different moments in the stack: v0 for component generation, Cursor for ongoing code editing. A faster path for new builds: use[Blink](https://blink.new/) to generate the full app — frontend and backend together — then optionally drop into Cursor for deeper editing via the Blink plugin. That skips the manual wiring step entirely.
